ops.title: auth --wait: replace the daemon ticker with a real session-liveness event
ops.description:
Option B from the cookiesync-auth-wait lane (2026-10-01). Shipped first as option A: `cookiesync auth --wait` parks in the daemon, which re-reads the local session every 5s and each approver candidate's `cookiesync rpc whoami` over ssh every 15s (`Broker.AwaitApprover`, internal/auth/await.go).

Why a ticker: synckit `presence` is a point-in-time ioreg/netstat read, `consent.Router.Live` is a one-shot ssh probe, and releases build with CGO_ENABLED=0, so the daemon cannot observe macOS unlock notifications itself.

Shape (3 PRs, in order):
1. helper: a `watch-session` mode in the signed Swift helper that observes `com.apple.screenIsUnlocked` / `NSWorkspace.sessionDidBecomeActiveNotification` and streams one line per change; re-sign, notarize, brew helper release.
2. synckit: `presence.Watch(ctx)` over that stream, plus a parked peer leg (`whoami --wait`) the Router can hold per candidate and take the first live answer; release synckit.
3. cookiesync: bump synckit, serve `whoami --wait` from the daemon, rewrite `AwaitApprover` on both events, delete the ticker and the Local/PeerAwaitInterval fields.

ops.text: AwaitApprover wakes on a local unlock event and on a peer's parked whoami --wait reply, with no ticker left in internal/auth/await.go
Each PR in the 3-PR shape merged and released: helper watch-session, synckit router/presence wait, cookiesync bump
